snippet.title: Bio-Defense for the Atari 8-bit family
snippet.description:
Came also out for:

---


Game description:

In Bio-Defense a human body is suffering from high degree fever and you have to cure the body by absorbing the viruses.


What I think:

Bio-Defense is unique, but gameplay-wise it's lacking a little...
